notes.title: A.I. Space Corps goes Final Release
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that A.I. Space Corps completed its Early Access phase and is now available as full version! Many new features, missions and locations made it into the game.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/423180

A.I. Space Corps is a top-down space shooter taking place in the far future universe of A.I. Invasion. As the captain of a space ship it is your duty to defend bases, transmit intelligence through enemy sectors and reclaim occupied stations. Can you survive the dangers of outer space and fight back the merciless A.I.?

[u]Full list of features[/u]
[list]
    [*]3 different ships with distinct attributes
    [*]flexible weapon upgrades throughout missions
    [*]strategic gameplay through various board systems like secondary weapon or temporary shields
    [*]different merciless enemy robots that have to be approached strategically
    [*]various challenge missions and Steam leaderboards to compete on
[/list]

The A.I. Space Corps Team

notes.title: Challenge update :: General improvements
notes.content:
[h1]Another update to A.I. Space Corps adds a new challenge and improves some previously released missions.[/h1]

"Astro Invaders" is the name of the new challenge and as the name suggests íts gameplay is mainly inspired by classic arcade shooters like Space Invaders! Defend giant space cruisers while piloting through a dangerous asteroid field. New dangers await on this challenging highscore hunt!

Once more we also improved the existing content based an the opinions our players voiced! Some new, slightly more intelligent enemies are approaching the Sinae system. But mankind won't fall behind because new weapon upgrades are also scattered around space-time!

The A.I. Space Corps Team

notes.title: A.I. Space Corps becomes challenging!
notes.content:
[h1]A big update for A.I. Space Corps was just released! Find out more about the cruel plans of the A.I. machines in a brand new story mission and engage in  the exciting highscore hunt with 2 new challenges![/h1]

Many player had the feeling that the story of A.I. Space Corps is progressing too slow and was not engaging enough. They were looking for a faster paced arcadey experience. With todays update we restructure the game into 2 sections - the classic story and the challenge mode.

[h1]Chimary Liberation Story[/h1]
This linear campaign tells the story about mankinds struggle against the menacing invasion of the A.I. Explore the Chimary Galaxy, fighting A.I. approaches and free your people from the opression by the merciless machines.

[h1]Challenges[/h1]
In this mode you can challenge your knowledge and dexterity when it comes to classic, arcade-style space shooting action! How long can you survive the various trials of A.I. Space Corps and will you be able to top the Steam leaderboards? Check out your scores here:
http://steamcommunity.com/stats/423180/leaderboards/1098169/


Tell us what you think about this update! Join our Steam discussion forums to talk to our developers and let us know what kind of missions and challenges you wanna see in future!

The A.I. Space Corps Team

notes.title: Christmas Update
notes.content:
[h1]Just in time for Christmas, another update for A.I. Space Corps rolled out![/h1]

We added the bonus mission „Duct Disaster“. It is unlocked by completing the tutorial mission, so most of you should already be eligible to compete!
In this mission the crew races through a narrow shaft, followed by a deadly A.I. robot. The foe is indestructible, so the only way out is to avoid obstacles, grab heals and bonus points and escape! Just like all other bonus mission scores, everyone’s best performance is tracked on the Steam leaderboards:

http://steamcommunity.com/stats/423180/leaderboards/1105326


The A.I. Space Corps Team

notes.title: First content update!
notes.content:
[h1]A new update for A.I. Space Corps was just released![/h1]
With this update we're introducing the sixth story mission "Descending Star" that leads players to a field of rubble right in front of a dying star. The crew has to look out for periodic stalar bursts burning down everything in their way.

[h1]What is to come?[/h1]
As detailed on the Steam store front we will be developing new missions and features until A.I. Space Corps is complete. You can expect regular content updates like this one in future.

According to the feedback we collected players are looking for more arcade-style missions and modes in A.I. Space Corps. As direct response we are planning to implement more special bonus missions that are based on classic arcade experiences.

If you already unlocked the mission "Wormhole Madness" by completing the third campaign mission "Sinae Wormhole" you can compete with other players on our Steam leaderboards:
http://steamcommunity.com/stats/423180/leaderboards/1098169/

All bonus missions are listing in the location "Bonus Missions" within the campaign.


The A.I. Space Corps Team
